project.name: inventory-wms-app
project.description: Warehouse management system (WMS) for tracking inventory, purchase orders, transfers, and warehouse operations. Single-page application with real-time Firebase sync.
project.purpose: Multi-warehouse inventory management with real-time tracking, purchase orders, inter-warehouse transfers, activity logging, and UPC barcode lookup.

architecture.stateManagement: React hooks (useState/useEffect) — no external state library
architecture.dataSync: Real-time Firestore via custom useCollection hook
architecture.routing: Custom in-app page state (no React Router)
security: Email verification required for data access
Firestore security rules with deny-all default
Cloud Functions for server-side API key protection

core.purpose: Main monolithic component with all business logic, page navigation, modal states, Firebase CRUD, activity logging
Authentication UI — email/password signup/login and Google OAuth
Centralized TypeScript interfaces for all data models

components.purpose: Generic table component with search, sorting, filtering, expandable rows (uses TypeScript generics)
Command-palette-style global search for inventory items with keyboard navigation
Reusable modal dialog with title, children, and footer slots
Alert/confirm dialog with imperative API via useRef handle
Toast notification with auto-dismiss and undo support
Color-coded status badge for inventory health (healthy/low/negative)

dashboard.purpose: Dashboard overview — low stock, negative stock, recent adjustments, frequent changes panels

inventory.purpose: Modal for adjusting inventory quantities with validation, large-adjustment warnings, activity logging
Detailed item view with overview, activity history, and metadata tabs

transfers.purpose: DataTable displaying inter-warehouse transfers with filtering and actions
Modal for managing transfer tracking numbers and labels

activityHistory.purpose: Activity log viewer with date range filtering, CSV export, user/action filtering

hooks.purpose: Real-time Firestore collection sync with optional where-clause filters, generic type support, loading state

utils.purpose: Utility functions: jsonSafeParse, sanitizeImageUrl (XSS protection), UPC product lookup (Go-UPC/UPCItemDB/OpenFoodFacts), buildBasePath, parseCsvSimple
Firebase auth error code to human-readable message mapping

tests.purpose: Unit tests for auth error handling

styling.purpose: CSS custom properties for light/dark theme, Tailwind directives, theme colors

endpoints.name: lookupUPC
endpoints.purpose: Server-side UPC barcode product lookup with three-tier API fallback

InventoryItem.purpose: Current inventory item with stock tracking

PurchaseOrderItem.purpose: Individual line item within a purchase order

TransferLine.purpose: Individual line item within a transfer

ActivityLog.purpose: Audit trail entry for user actions

collections.rateLimits: Rate limiting data for Cloud Functions

firestoreRules.rateLimits: Requires authenticated user, scoped to own userId
firestoreRules.userProfiles: Read: any authenticated user; Write: own profile only
firestoreRules.optionalDomainRestriction: Can restrict to specific email domains

environmentVariables.VITE_GOUPC_API_KEY: Go-UPC API key (optional, prefer Cloud Functions)
environmentVariables.VITE_UPCITEMDB_KEY: UPCItemDB API key (optional, prefer Cloud Functions)
environmentVariables.VITE_USE_CLOUD_FUNCTIONS: Feature flag to enable Cloud Functions for UPC lookup

configFiles.vite.config.ts: Vite build config with API proxy for Go-UPC and UPCItemDB in development
configFiles.tailwind.config.cjs: TailwindCSS config with dark mode (class strategy) support
configFiles.eslint.config.js: ESLint with React and TypeScript plugins
configFiles.firebase.json: Firebase hosting (public: dist) and functions config with security headers
configFiles.firestore.rules: Firestore security rules with multi-tenancy isolation
configFiles.tsconfig.json: Root TypeScript config with project references
configFiles.tsconfig.app.json: App TypeScript config (ES2022 target, strict mode, JSX preserve)
configFiles.postcss.config.js: PostCSS with TailwindCSS and Autoprefixer plugins

documentation.CLAUDE.md: Project overview, structure, commands, and working guidelines
documentation.SECURITY.md: Security best practices for API keys and Firebase
documentation.QUICKSTART_CLOUD_FUNCTIONS.md: Quick start guide for Cloud Functions
documentation..claude/docs/architectural_patterns.md: Design patterns, conventions, and file:line references

keyPatterns: Monolithic App.tsx (~4000 lines) centralizes all business logic and state
Feature-based directory organization (dashboard, inventory, transfers, activityHistory)
Real-time Firestore sync via custom useCollection hook with onSnapshot
Three-tier UPC lookup fallback chain (Go-UPC -> UPCItemDB -> OpenFoodFacts)
Activity logging as audit trail for all data mutations
Toast notifications with undo support for quantity adjustments
URL sanitization to prevent XSS attacks on image URLs
Dark mode support via CSS custom properties and Tailwind class strategy
